changelog: **Open-text engine, part 2 (#2046):** the survey summary (#1910) now runs on `summarizeOpenText` — themes with the answers behind each (clickable on the results page), a four-bucket sentiment flag, verbatim quotes, caveats, cached as an `AiArtifact` and regenerable; the engine floor is the survey's k-floor applied to the question's written answers. `src/lib/surveyTextSummary.ts` and `parseSummary` are gone (the engine owns verification). New "what changed" paragraph on `/admin/analytics` (`GET|POST /api/admin/analytics/narrative`): the figures are recomputed server-side from the new `src/lib/adminAnalyticsData.ts` (which `GET /api/admin/analytics` now also returns from), sent as `label: value` facts with no names, and the reply is discarded unless every number it cites is in the facts (`acceptNarrative`, golden case in `scripts/test/narrative-rules.test.mjs`). `/ai` lists seven features.

en: The AI summary of a survey question now shows how many answers each theme stands for and opens them on click.
The analytics page can write a short “what changed” paragraph from its own figures — and throws it away if it cites a number that is not on the page.
tr: Bir anket sorusunun yapay zekâ özeti artık her temanın kaç yanıta dayandığını gösteriyor ve tıklayınca o yanıtları açıyor.
Analiz sayfası kendi rakamlarından kısa bir “ne değişti” paragrafı yazabiliyor — sayfada olmayan bir sayı anarsa paragrafı atıyor.
de: Die KI-Zusammenfassung einer Umfragefrage zeigt jetzt, für wie viele Antworten jedes Thema steht, und öffnet sie per Klick.
Die Analyseseite kann aus ihren eigenen Zahlen einen kurzen Absatz „Was sich verändert hat“ schreiben — und verwirft ihn, wenn er eine Zahl nennt, die nicht auf der Seite steht.
